info.title: Cisco IOS-XE Native Config - Interface — Physical Ethernet
info.description:
Physical Ethernet interface configuration for all speed variants.

**Types covered (13):** Ethernet, FastEthernet, GigabitEthernet, TwoGigabitEthernet, FiveGigabitEthernet, AppGigabitEthernet, TenGigabitEthernet, TwentyFiveGigE, FortyGigabitEthernet, FiftyGigabitEthernet, HundredGigE, TwoHundredGigE, FourHundredGigE

**Common features per interface:** IP addressing, switchport, description, shutdown, speed/duplex, service-policy, access-group, spanning-tree

**YANG:** Cisco-IOS-XE-native interface container + augments from policy, acl, spanning-tree, etc.

**YANG Model:** [Cisco IOS-XE Native Config - Interface — Physical Ethernet.yang](https://github.com/YangModels/yang/blob/main/vendor/cisco/xe/17181/Cisco IOS-XE Native Config - Interface — Physical Ethernet.yang)

get.description:
Retrieve all Ethernet interface configurations.

CLI equivalent: `show running-config | section interface Ethernet`

Returns a list of Ethernet interfaces with their name (key), IP addressing, shutdown state, description, and augmented features (QoS service-policy, ACL bindings, etc.).

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Limit the depth of returned sub-tree data (RFC 8040 Section 4.8.2). Use 'unbounded' for full depth.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Select specific fields to return (RFC 8040 Section 4.8.3). Example: fields=name;status

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: Filter by config state: 'config' (config true only), 'nonconfig' (config false only), or 'all'.

patch.description: Merge update to Ethernet interface configurations.
